description: Find HS or SITC commodity codes by keyword, partial description, or code prefix in the selected classification. Returns descriptions, native aggregation levels, parents, leaf status, and recommendedQueryCode for subsequent trade queries. HS uses levels 2 (chapter), 4 (heading), and 6 (subheading); SITC uses levels 1–5. Select the edition matching the trade records when interpreting historical codes. Each page holds up to limit matches; continue with nextOffset using the same query, classification, and aggr_level.

aggr_level.description: Native aggregation level: HS uses 2 (chapter), 4 (heading), 6 (subheading); SITC uses 1–5. Omit to return all matching levels.

classification.description: Goods reference catalog, case-insensitive: HS uses the default HS.json discovery catalog, whose total identifies H6; it is not an authoritative historical-edition reference. Select H0–H6 for an explicit HS edition, or SS/S1–S4 for SITC.

limit.description: Maximum matching codes returned per page; defaults to 50.

offset.description: Number of matching codes to skip; use nextOffset to continue.

query.description: Keyword, partial description, or commodity code prefix. Examples: "motor vehicles", "8471", "coffee", "84" (HS chapter 84 = machinery).

name: comtrade_search_commodities

classification.description: Reference catalog used for the search.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_aggregation_level`: The requested level does not belong to the selected classification family. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matches.description: Commodity codes on this page matching the query in the selected classification, in catalog order.

items.description: A commodity entry from the selected catalog.

aggrLevel.description: Native aggregation level in the selected HS or SITC catalog; 0 is the all-commodities TOTAL, which no aggr_level filter returns.

id.description: Commodity code in the selected classification, preserving leading zeros.

isLeaf.description: Whether this code has no sub-codes (leaf node in the HS hierarchy).

parent.description: Parent commodity code in the selected classification.

recommendedQueryCode.description: Code to pass as cmd_code with the same classification in trade data queries.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page; absent when no matching codes remain.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no codes match, matches remain past this page, or the offset is past the end. Absent otherwise.

offset.description: Number of matching codes skipped for this page.

shown.description: Number of codes returned on this page.

totalMatches.description: Total matching codes across all pages.

truncated.description: Whether this page holds only part of the matching codes (shown < totalMatches).

title: Search Commodity Codes
